description: List the companies in your Codat account. A company represents one of your customers' businesses and holds its data connections. Codat API: GET /companies. Returns the paged envelope { results, pageNumber, pageSize, totalResults, _links }.

orderBy.description: Field to order results by, e.g. "-modifiedDate" (leading "-" for descending).

query.description: Codat query filter string, e.g. "status=Paid" or "modifiedDate>2026-01-01". See docs.codat.io/using-the-api/querying.

name: codat_list_companies
title: List companies
